1. Walking with the Candelabra: Walks slowly down the grand corridor, flickering candlelight casting dancing shadows on the oil paintings
2. Unlocking the Secret Door: Turns an ornate brass key in the hidden bookcase lock, pulling the heavy wooden panel open
3. Finding the Forbidden Journal: Opens a dusty leather-bound diary, fingers trembling slightly as the faded handwriting is revealed
4. Looking over the Shoulder: Freezes in place as a floorboard creaks behind, slowly turning around into the darkness
5. Blowing Out the Flame: Blows gently on the candle flame, plunging the scene into dramatic moonlit silhouette
